title: Complete implementation
adaptationNote: The unchanged shared course_test.hpp from Book II B02-L0110 is placed first; the local include is removed. CHECK stays active in optimized builds.

guide.problem: Visit a hierarchy and measure its shape.
guide.design: Recursive traversal follows each subtree. An explicit work stack is safer when input depth can exceed the call stack.
guide.invariant: Every reachable tree node is visited according to the selected order; child ownership has no cycle.
guide.failure: A missing null base case dereferences no object. Accidental cycles make a tree traversal fail to terminate.
guide.trace: Preorder visits root before children; inorder places root between left and right.
guide.maintenance: Document whether height counts nodes or edges, especially for an empty tree.
guide.scope: This panel connects this listing to its chapter’s problem. Short demonstrations illustrate one part; the chapter’s complete implementation and invariant labs test the broader contract.

experiment: Predict one boundary or tie case, then change this listing and trace the affected state. Preorder visits root before children; inorder places root between left and right.

checks.label: Original behavior
checks.hint: Compare the first changed output, assertion, or process exit. Preserve the stated invariant before changing the expected result.
